title: The baklava my mother makes
goal: Put a noun doer in the genitive before a -DIk participle: Ali'nin okuduğu kitap, annemin yaptığı baklava, tanıştığımız gün.

intro.text: When the doer is a noun, it goes in the genitive, like an owner, and the participle takes *-(s)I*: *Ali'nin okuduğu kitap* (the book Ali is reading), *annemin yaptığı baklava* (the baklava my mother makes). Pronoun doers are usually dropped: *okuduğum kitap*.

vocab.en: to meet, to get to know (each other)

exercises.question: How do you say **the book Ali is reading**?

why.1: The doer takes the genitive, like an owner: *Ali'nin*.
why.2: *Okuyan* would make the book the reader. The book is the object, so `-DIk`.
why.3: The participle comes before its noun: *okuduğu kitap*.

exercises.explain: *Ali'nin okuduğu kitap*: the pattern of *Ali'nin kitabı*, with the participle in place of the possessed noun.

exercises.en: The baklava my mother makes is delicious.

reject.why: The doer of a `-DIk` participle takes the genitive: *annemin yaptığı*.
*Annemi* is the accusative. The doer takes the genitive: *annemin*.

exercises.explain: *anne-m-in*: my mother, in the genitive, as the doer of *yaptığı*.

exercises.prompt: This is the recipe my grandmother gave me.

reject.why: The doer takes the genitive: *anneannemin bana verdiği*.

accept: Do you remember the day we met?
Do you remember the day [that|when] we met?
Do you remember the day we first met?

exercises.explain: After the voiceless p, d becomes t: *yap-tığ*. Then *-ı* for **she**, with no s, since a consonant comes before it.

exercises.en: We went to the restaurant you suggested.
The books the children read are very colourful.

reject.why: The doer takes the genitive: *çocukların okuduğu*.

exercises.explain: *çocuk-lar-ın*: the plural doer in the genitive. The participle usually stays singular: *okuduğu*.

exercises.prompt: The house our neighbour lives in is very old.

exercises.tr: Bu, babamın bana aldığı ilk saat.
exercises.en: This is the first watch my father bought me.
options: Bu, babamın bana aldığı ilk saat.
Bu, babamın aldığı ilk saat mi?

exercises.question: Which is the most natural way to say **the house we live in**?

why.1: With *bizim*, the participle still needs *-umuz*: *bizim oturduğumuz ev*. And the pronoun is usually dropped.
why.2: A pronoun doer takes the genitive: *bizim*, not *biz*.

exercises.explain: The ending *-umuz* already says **we**: *oturduğumuz ev*. Add *bizim* only to stress it.

exercises.prompt: Where is the cake you made?

reject.why: The cake didn't do the making: you did. Use `-DIk`: *yaptığın pasta*.

accept: I have finished the homework the teacher gave us.
I [finished|did|have done] the homework [the teacher gave|that the teacher gave|the teacher gave us|the teacher gave me|that the teacher gave us|that the teacher gave me].
I have finished the homework [the teacher gave|that the teacher gave|the teacher gave me|that the teacher gave us|that the teacher gave me].
